correctness.rationale: Constant-term identity CT(3+X+2/X)^n produces D_n and digit multiplicativity excludes 2 mod3. Sparse powers yield D_{a+2*3^r}=D_a*c_k mod3^k for sufficiently separated blocks. c_k=D_{2*3^(k-1)}=7 mod9 for k>=2 generates principal units by lifting exponent. Low-degree Legendre coefficients at odd n=3^(a-1) and even n=3^a+1 produce valuation a with both leading unit signs. These seeds, principal-unit powers, and arbitrarily spaced blocks prove all allowed residues infinitely. Independent integer recurrence computation through n=16002 observed precisely 2*3^(k-1) classes for k=1..4; finite check is corroboration only.
